name: scar
description: Scar tissue for your coding agent: when CI, a review bot or a human catches what Claude should have caught earlier, log the miss and turn repeated feedback into checks for future reviews. Pipeline gap tracking, PR-feedback review calibration and a confidence ladder for lessons.
